enrollment.what: Census Day (first Wednesday in October) enrollment: TA = total, SG_EL = English learners, SG_DS = students with disabilities

absenteeism.what: Chronic absenteeism rate (share of students absent 10% or more of the days they were enrolled), all students

note: Whole host school, not only the magnet program. Context, never a ranking or a quality judgment. Shown as plain fractions ('about 1 in 6'), never percentages. Suppressed or missing cells stay null with a reason.
